title: Looks right to a person
description: Before/after screenshots of every view (light/dark, desktop/phone) reviewed by someone other than the builder: no broken layout, the brand still recognisable, hierarchy clearer.
criterion: Before/after screenshots of every view (light/dark, desktop/phone) reviewed by someone other than the builder: no broken layout, the brand still recognisable, hierarchy clearer.
prerequisites: Screenshots from `node scripts/ui-check/check.mjs --shots after/` (and the same command on the previous version for before/).

steps.action: Compare before/after screenshots of every view in light and dark, desktop and phone.
steps.expected: No broken or overlapping layout, nothing cut off, text clearly readable.

steps.action: Look at the brand: logo, orange buttons, focus rings and progress bar.
steps.expected: QuickNotes still looks like QuickNotes; the orange is unchanged on fills and icons.

steps.action: Look at the hierarchy on a note row (text, time, chips).
steps.expected: Note text stands out; secondary info is quieter but readable.
